steps.code:
# Parse the old_songs.txt content to extract song titles
old_songs_content = file_data['content']
old_song_titles = []
for line in old_songs_content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- " and then split on " by " to get title
        song_part = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (case sensitive) - take first part as title
        if ' by ' in song_part:
            title = song_part.split(' by ')[0].strip()
            old_song_titles.append(title)
        else:
            # If no " by ", treat whole as title
            old_song_titles.append(song_part.strip())

print("Old song titles:", old_song_titles)
